blocks.text: CLEANOUT FAQ
Cleanout Services in Richmond Hill — Straight Questions, Honest Answers

items.q: What types of cleanout services do you provide in Richmond Hill?
a: We offer complete cleanout services for homes, condos, apartments, garages, basements, attics, storage units, offices, rental properties, estates, and commercial spaces. Whether you’re moving, downsizing, renovating, or clearing out a property, our team can help.

items.q: Can you remove large furniture and appliances?
a: Yes. We safely remove sofas, beds, mattresses, refrigerators, washers, dryers, office furniture, exercise equipment, and other bulky, non-hazardous items. We handle all the lifting, loading, and hauling.

items.q: Do I need to prepare my property before the cleanout?
a: No preparation is necessary. Simply identify the items you want removed, and our crew will take care of everything else, including sorting, lifting, and loading the unwanted items.

items.q: How long does a cleanout usually take?
a: The time required depends on the size of the property and the amount of junk. Most residential cleanouts are completed within a few hours, while larger estate or commercial cleanouts may take a full day.

items.q: Do you recycle or donate items after a cleanout?
a: Yes. We make every effort to donate reusable items and recycle eligible materials whenever possible. Any remaining waste is disposed of responsibly, helping reduce landfill waste while keeping your Richmond Hill property clean and clutter-free.
